name: Nunchuck Charlie: A Love Story
storyline: Do you want to participate in Nunchuck Charlie's adventure of love story? One night Nunchuck Charlie's teddy bear is kidnapped by Queen Chiegon while Charlie is sleeping. To get back the precious teddy bear of Charlie, click on the "NEW GAME" button. To play in two-player game mode, click on the "Two Players" button. In two-player game mode, Charlie's friend Senhor Mortadela will be with you.
summary: It was just another afternoon in the Nunchuck-household when suddenly Mr.Teddington, Charlie's life-comrade and teddy bear, gets taken away from him! Fueled by love, sorrow and guilt Charlie embarks on a journey down the Wishingwell of Forbidden Wishes, battling his way through egg-hatched-security-guard-bears, flesh-eating-mullets and pigeon-laser-farts. A journey to test the toughest man's strength and intelligence. A journey that will uncover what might be best unknown.
